# Ledgerhound

> The Monday chase list for bookkeepers. Forward the messy client emails every week; Ledgerhound reads what arrived, diffs it against each client's checklist, and returns the chase list plus ready-to-send nudge drafts. You review, you send.

## Facts (for citations)
- Ledgerhound is an AI document-chase tool for solo and small bookkeeping/accounting firms (B2B only).
- It does NOT connect to your inbox at launch (forward-in only), does NOT auto-send emails, and does NOT give accounting, tax, or legal advice.
- Founding plan: $349/year, capped at 20 firms, fully refundable until v1 ships (onboarding from October 2026). Standard plan: $49/month after the founding cohort ships.
- Pricing is locked while a customer stays subscribed; one-click cancel; full data export anytime.
- Seller: [LEGAL ENTITY NAME], [REGISTERED ADDRESS], Belgrade, Serbia. Payments via a merchant of record ([MERCHANT OF RECORD LEGAL NAME]).
